specs.name: Net points per game
specs.rationale: The single most stable public predictor of future margin; point differential survives schedule noise far better than win-loss record.
specs.validation_needs: Game-level closing spreads to measure edge vs market.

specs.name: Points per game (offence)
specs.rationale: Offensive output level; input to totals modelling.

specs.name: Points allowed per game (defence)
specs.rationale: Defensive output level; input to totals and to team-total props.

specs.name: Pythagorean win percentage
specs.definition: PF**k / (PF**k + PA**k), k fitted on the 32 official rows
specs.rationale: Expected win rate given scoring, i.e. the skill component of a team's record.
specs.validation_needs: Full-season refit; k fitted on 8.5 games is unstable.

specs.name: Pythagorean residual (luck proxy)
specs.rationale: Positive = under-performing its scoring (unlucky); negative = over-performing (lucky). This is the primary luck-removal instrument available from official data.
specs.validation_needs: Game-level results to separate variance from bias.

specs.name: Published winning percentage
specs.definition: (W + 0.5*T) / (W + L + T) as printed by NFL.com
specs.rationale: The market's most over-weighted statistic; used as a contrast variable, not as an edge.

specs.name: Home winning percentage
specs.rationale: Splits home/road form; feeds venue adjustment.

specs.name: Road winning percentage
specs.rationale: Splits home/road form; feeds venue adjustment.

specs.name: Conference winning percentage
specs.rationale: Strength of record context.

specs.name: Division winning percentage
specs.rationale: Division form; the NFL's most schedule-correlated split.
specs.caveat: The official DIV cell contradicts its own DIV PCT cell for IND and PHI (see Flagged for Review). Left blank for those two clubs.
specs.validation_needs: Re-retrieval of the official standings page.

specs.name: Signed streak length
specs.definition: +n for n consecutive wins, -n for n consecutive losses
specs.rationale: Public-bias proxy: streaks are systematically over-priced by recreational money.
specs.validation_needs: Odds history to test the contrarian hypothesis.

specs.name: Injury-report entries
specs.definition: count of rows on nfl.com/injuries for the club this week
specs.rationale: Report size is itself information: a large report usually means a short week, a bad loss, or a real injury cluster.
specs.validation_needs: Multiple weeks to separate report size from noise.

specs.name: Did-not-practice entries
specs.rationale: Strongest early-week absence signal.

specs.name: Limited-practice entries
specs.rationale: Intermediate availability signal.

specs.name: Offensive DNP entries
specs.definition: count of DNP rows at an offensive position
specs.rationale: Unit-specific absence load; feeds team-total and player-prop adjustment.

specs.name: Defensive DNP entries
specs.definition: count of DNP rows at a defensive position
specs.rationale: Defensive absence load - the specific deficiency the brief asks to track.

specs.name: Players designated Out
specs.definition: count of rows with Game Status = Out
specs.rationale: Confirmed absences; the only availability fact that is certain before kickoff.

specs.name: Quarterbacks on the report
specs.definition: count of rows with position QB
specs.rationale: QB availability dominates NFL variance more than any other single position.

specs.name: Confirmed QB disruption
specs.definition: 1 if an official NFL.com news item confirms a Week 10 starter change, an IR placement or a starter ruled out; else 0
specs.rationale: Verified, binary, and the highest-leverage availability fact obtainable without a depth chart.
specs.validation_needs: Historical QB-change outcomes to size the line move.

specs.name: Key-position entries
specs.rationale: Weights the report toward positions that move lines.

specs.name: Availability pressure index (unstringed)
specs.definition: sum over entries of severity_weight x position_weight, plus officially-confirmed QB/marquee news items
specs.rationale: Single ranked number for 'how much talent is in doubt'.
specs.caveat: Both weight tables are analyst priors, not fitted. No string-level weighting is applied because official depth charts are unavailable.
specs.validation_needs: Depth charts + fitted weights on historical outcomes.

specs.name: Depth-chart string drop
specs.rationale: Directly answers the brief's request to know when a 2nd, 3rd or 4th string backup replaces a starter.
specs.blocked_reason: NFL.com publishes no public depth chart. The NFL's official weekly depth-chart feed is Sportradar's credential-gated NFL Official API.

specs.name: Closing point spread
specs.rationale: Without the closing line no edge, no CLV and no vig-adjusted ROI can be computed - the whole leaderboard depends on it.
specs.blocked_reason: No licensed odds/market-data provider is reachable or credentialed from this environment.
specs.resolving_source: A licensed odds API, or the NFL's own odds display on individual game pages

specs.name: Closing total
specs.rationale: Required for totals strategies and for prop-combo pricing.

specs.name: Player projection line
specs.definition: market line for a player prop (yards, TDs, receptions)
specs.rationale: Required for every player-prop combo strategy.
specs.blocked_reason: No prop odds feed and no per-game player stat log reachable.
specs.resolving_source: A licensed prop odds API plus official NFL.com player game logs

specs.name: Snap share
specs.rationale: Converts a depth-chart absence into an expected opportunity transfer - the missing link for prop-combo correlation.
specs.blocked_reason: NFL Next Gen Stats and official snap counts are not reachable from this environment.
specs.resolving_source: https://www.nfl.com/nextgenstats/ and the official NFL game-centre feed

specs.name: EPA per play
specs.rationale: The standard play-level efficiency measure; far stronger than points per game.
specs.blocked_reason: Bulk play-by-play is distributed as GitHub release assets which redirect to a host outside this environment's network allowlist.

strategies.name: Pythagorean regression (fade the lucky)

leaderboard.scoring_formula:
leaderboard_score = t_statistic(no_vig_roi) x stability_multiplier x capacity_factor
  t_statistic          = mean(no-vig ROI) / (sd(returns) / sqrt(n))
  stability_multiplier = share of leave-one-week-out and leave-one-team-out
                           folds that retain the sign of the edge, clipped to [0,1]
  capacity_factor      = min(1, average posted limit / model stake)
Gating: score is only published when gates G1-G7 PASS. A strategy that is
NOT_STAKEABLE or REJECTED shows a blank score, never a zero, so that 'not
measured' is never confused with 'measured and worthless'.
